It's about a logical explanation of the decisions: why this typography was chosen, why the mark is simple or more distinctive, why a particular color palette was used and how the direction supports the brand. If the company sells a premium service, the rationale may concern calm, proportions and a limited palette. Najczęstszy błąd to projektowanie wyłącz: The most common mistake is designing purely to taste. Such a mark may look impressive on a large board, but it loses its strength in real applications.

The company receives one logo, most often horizontal, and later tries to use it everywhere: in a square profile icon, in the footer, on a light background, on a photo, in print and in ads. Im lepiej przygotowany jest start projek: The better prepared the start of the project, the easier it is to create a mark that won't be a random graphic. It's not about the client coming with a ready vision and a detailed sketch. It's often better when they bring context: a description of the company, the most important services, examples of materials they like, examples of competitors they want to avoid, information about the audience and the planned places where the logo will be used.
Bardzo pomocne są także obecne materiały: Current brand materials are also very helpful: the old website, business cards, the PDF proposal, social media, product photos, packaging or ads. Even if they're going to be changed, they show how the company has communicated so far and where problems arose. Sometimes the biggest clue isn't what the client wants to add, but what bothers them about the current image: an amateurish impression, a lack of consistency, difficulty using the logo, poor legibility or no print version.
Warto zebrać dotychczasowe logo, ofertę,: It's worth gathering the existing logo, the proposal, the website, posts, documents and examples of places where the mark will be used.
Dobrze opisać, jaki efekt marka chce osi: It's good to describe what effect the brand wants to achieve: more trust, a more premium feel, modernity, simplicity or greater recognition.
Trzeba wskazać, czy logo będzie używane: You need to indicate whether the logo will be used on clothing, packaging, shop signs, products, dark photos, small icons or in campaigns.
Inspiracje są pomocne, ale nie powinny z: Inspirations are helpful, but they shouldn't replace strategy
Inspiracje pomagają określić kierunek es: Inspirations help define the aesthetic direction, but they shouldn't be treated as a ready-made recipe. If a client shows three competitors' marks and asks for “something similar”, the design can quickly enter the dangerous territory of repetitiveness. A better approach is to talk about what works in those examples: simplicity, proportions, color, energy, elegance, minimalism, contrast, the character of the typography or the way the brand is presented.
Dzięki temu projektant może stworzyć zna: That way the designer can create a mark tailored to the company, not a copy of a mood found online. This is especially important for brands that want to look professional for several years, not just come across well on the day the design is presented. Graphic trends change quickly, but a well-designed mark should have a solid foundation: legibility, proportions and consistency with the brand.
Od czego zależy koszt projektu logo?: What does the cost of a logo design depend on?
Koszt logo zależy przede wszystkim od za: The cost of a logo depends primarily on the scope of work. A simple mark design for a small business is priced differently than a fuller process covering strategy, competitor analysis, several creative directions, refined typography, a complete set of variants, a mini brand book and preparing starter materials. In practice, the client doesn't pay just for a graphic file, but for decisions, tests and putting the brand in order.
Tanie logo często jest tańsze tylko na p: A cheap logo is often cheaper only at the beginning. If after a few months it turns out that the mark doesn't work on the website, has no print version, no vector files, doesn't fit the offer or looks similar to competitors, the company has to go back to it and pay a second time. That's why, when assessing the budget, it's worth looking not only at the starting price, but at whether the project solves the brand's real needs.

However, if the company is planning advertising campaigns, an online store, an extensive website, printed materials, presentations and social media communication, it's worth treating the logo as part of a larger system. Then logo design isn't the cost of a “pretty little mark”, but an investment in a consistent image and convenient everyday communication.
Gdzie nowe logo powinno pojawić się w pi: Where should the new logo appear first?
Po zakończeniu projektu warto wdrożyć lo: At the end of the project, it's worth rolling out the logo consistently rather than replacing it randomly in selected places. The touchpoints clients see most often should be updated first: the website, the Google profile, social media, the email signature, the PDF proposal, business cards, sales documents and ads. That way the brand immediately looks more consistent and doesn't create an impression of transitional mess.
Szczególnie ważna jest strona internetow: The website is especially important. That's where clients most often check whether a company is credible. If the new logo is already refined, but the website still uses the old colors, random fonts and inconsistent graphics, the effect of the rebrand will be weaker. The logo should bring with it an overhaul of the most important visual elements: headings, buttons, icons, sections, forms and downloadable materials.

Dobrze przeprowadzone wdrożenie zmniejsz: A well-executed rollout reduces chaos. Clients don't see the old and new mark at the same time, and the team knows which files to use. This matters even in a small company, because inconsistency can keep coming back for months: once someone uses an old PNG, another time the previous color, and yet another time a stretched version of the logo from a document. Order in the files and rules helps avoid this.

Czym różni się logo od brandingu?: What's the difference between a logo and branding?
Logo to znak marki: logotyp, sygnet lub: A logo is the brand's mark: a logotype, a symbol or a combination of both. Branding covers a broader system: colors, typography, photo style, composition, materials, usage rules and the way the brand is presented. The logo is an important element of branding, but it doesn't replace the whole identity.
Jakie pliki logo powinienem otrzymać?: Which logo files should I receive?
Najlepiej otrzymać pliki wektorowe do sk: Ideally you should receive vector files for scaling and print, e.g. SVG, PDF or EPS, and raster files for online use, e.g. PNG and JPG. It's also worth having color and monochrome versions, versions for light and dark backgrounds and a favicon for the website.
Czy logo powinno zawierać symbol?: Should a logo include a symbol?
Nie zawsze. Niektóre marki świetnie dzia: Not always. Some brands work great as a logotype alone, based on typography. A symbol is useful when the brand needs a short form, a favicon, a social media icon or a mark that can be used independently of the full name.
Czy można odświeżyć obecne logo zamiast: Can you refresh your current logo instead of designing a new one?
Tak, jeśli obecny znak ma potencjał i je: Yes, if the current mark has potential and is recognizable, but needs refining. The proportions, typography, colors, file versions and usage rules can be improved. However, if the mark doesn't fit the brand or limits its growth, a new design may be the better solution.
Co jest ważniejsze: ładny wygląd czy pra: What's more important: good looks or practical use?
Najlepsze logo łączy jedno i drugie. Mus: The best logo combines both. It must look good, but it should also work in real places: on the website, on social media, in print, in ads, and in company and sales materials. A visual effect without usability quickly becomes a problem.
